## Specify paths to input data 
We specify the directory from which we will retrieve input data.


```{r eval=FALSE}
path_to_input_1L_chr <- "ADD PATH HERE"
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
path_to_input_1L_chr <- params$path_to_input_1L_chr
```

We also provide the names of the files within this directory that we wish to ingest.

```{r eval=FALSE}
file_names_ls <- list(extended = "ADD XLSX FILE NAME HERE",
                      summary = "ADD XLSX FILE NAME HERE")
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
file_names_ls <- params$file_names_ls
```


## Specify path to output data directory
We specify the directory in which we will save all project outputs.

```{r eval=FALSE}
path_to_output_1L_chr <- "ADD PATH HERE"
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
path_to_output_1L_chr <- params$path_to_output_1L_chr
```

We also provide the name of the sub-directory in which R objects (RDS format) will be saved.

```{r}
r_dir_1L_chr <- "R"
```
